attempts.prompt:
Create one finished Wu Yi (吴懿) animation line-art frame 360, exactly the wide shot of the FIRST input block, not the text/layout around it. Landscape target1920x1080, clean white background, thin gray-black ink contours. No text, box construction, borders, other people, background, water, color, glow or solid shadows.
Frame geometry on native1672x941: head center[1343, 422]; two planted feet[1298, 787]/[1402, 782]; action shoulder/elbow/wrist[1302, 486]/[1284, 548]/[1266, 584]. Whole character is small, only about 42% of frame height at far right. Full crown through shoes visible. Camera has pulled back; keep large white space above. Do not move the figure toward center or zoom to portrait.
CRITICAL: Wu Yi's own right arm (on the screen-left side of her body) has ALREADY LOWERED AFTER RELEASE. Right shoulder points downward to elbow, forearm angles down-left and wrist/fingers hang visibly BELOW THE WAIST beside the thigh. Do not extend the hand toward the ship or copy the lifted-palm pose from inputs3/4. Her other hand is close to the waist, elbow gently out. Her head, torso and shoes face left toward the boat, calm observant adult expression; long skirt and broad soft cuffs settle naturally around grounded feet.
The same single suspended wooden ship is on the LEFT, separate from her by white air. Its full bounds approximately x380..1086, y360..738; include the eaves without letting the ship overlap the woman. Keep the exact same wooden three-level pavilion vessel design of inputs4/5: bird-carved prow, feather-like stern ornament, warm planked hull rendered only in ink, tiered upturned eaves, windows and rails. No green energy shell, no basin or metal object. Ship hovers off ground without water.
Input2, S1 master, is the only identity/costume authority: preserve adult long oval face, softly rounded jaw, fine calm eyes, tiny forehead dot, middle-part forehead and coiled hair, petal-wing crown with chains, earrings/neckband, asymmetric chest edge without mirroring, one narrow sash and hanging bands, curved broad sleeves, full long skirt and closed flat shoes. Input3 is immutable314 linework style only. Input4 locks the same ship linework only, never its outstretched arm. Input5 supplies ship architecture only, take no street scenery. Clean organic fine lines, no filled black hair or heavy wash. One finished drawing only.
